question: Who is the first woman judge of Supreme Court of India ?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Justice Fathima M. Beevi__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice Fathima M. Beevi** was the **first woman judge of the Supreme Court of India**.

 
 
• **She** was **appointed** to the **apex Court in 1989**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice Leila Seth** was the **first woman judge of the Delhi High Court**.
